description: Ministry of Labour - Collective Agreement no 04 of 2024 between National Saving Bank and the Ceylon Bank Employees Union of NSB
categorisation: The gazette content is the official publication of a Collective Agreement between the National Savings Bank and a trade union, as mandated by Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act. Its primary purpose is to formalize and give legal effect to this agreement, making it a regulatory matter under existing labor law. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit other specialized categories like Land, Commercial, or Public Service. It falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as a statutory instrument/subsidiary legislation.
